source.archive: NASA HEASARC Fermi GBM trigger archive
source.terms: Fermi Science Support Center data policy page (https://fermi.gsfc.nasa.gov/ssc/data/policy/, saved as fermi-policy.html) says: 'GBM data were not proprietary at any time during the mission and are released as early as possible during science operations.' No licence text beyond that was found; the NASA website disclaimer page was saved but states no data licence.

header.TRIGTIME: 524666471.474598 (trigger time relative to MJDREF, double precision)

corroboration: Goldstein et al. 2017 (arXiv:1710.05446, sha256 1241539d44bfd263a5faa2fde3e636f441cf468e4fd79c1d1690dc26acfc3c72) states: 'On August 17, 2017 at 12:41:06 UTC the Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM) detected and triggered'; to the second only.
